wake.title: Waking up the server
wake.body: The free API goes to sleep when idle. The first request can take up to a minute; after that it is fast.

title.default: We couldn't read the F1 data

body.network: There is no connection to the API. Check your network and retry.
body.timeout: The API did not respond within 90 seconds.
body.upstream: The F1 data provider is unavailable right now.
body.notFound: The race you asked for no longer exists in the API. Pick another one from the calendar.
body.unknown: The API responded with an unexpected error.

upstreamReason.timeout: The provider took too long to respond.
upstreamReason.server-error: The provider responded with an error.
upstreamReason.empty-response: The provider returned an empty response.

emptyRace.title: Pick a race
emptyRace.body: Once you pick one from the calendar, the circuit, the lap-by-lap forecast, the tyres that fit that weather and the grid show up here.

invalid.title: The backend rejected the strategy
invalid.body_one: It found {{count}} problem. Fix it in the builder and simulate again.
invalid.body_other: It found {{count}} problems. Fix them in the builder and simulate again.

emptyResult.title: You haven't simulated yet
emptyResult.body: Build your strategy and press SIMULATE. The result shows up here: total time, stints, pit stops and how the pace changes lap by lap.

violations.NO_STINTS: The strategy needs at least one stint.
violations.STINT_TOO_SHORT: Stint {{stint}} has {{laps}} laps. Every stint needs at least 1 whole lap.
violations.UNKNOWN_COMPOUND: Stint {{stint}} uses "{{compound}}", which is not a valid compound. Options: {{allowed}}.
violations.LAPS_MISMATCH_missing_one: Stints add up to {{actual}} laps but the race has {{expected}}. {{count}} lap is missing.
violations.LAPS_MISMATCH_missing_other: Stints add up to {{actual}} laps but the race has {{expected}}. {{count}} laps are missing.
violations.LAPS_MISMATCH_extra_one: Stints add up to {{actual}} laps but the race has {{expected}}. {{count}} lap too many.
violations.LAPS_MISMATCH_extra_other: Stints add up to {{actual}} laps but the race has {{expected}}. {{count}} laps too many.
violations.NOT_ENOUGH_PIT_STOPS_one: At least {{count}} pit stop is required but the strategy has {{actual}}.
violations.NOT_ENOUGH_PIT_STOPS_other: At least {{count}} pit stops are required but the strategy has {{actual}}.

empty.title: No races on the calendar
empty.body: The API returned no races. Try again in a moment.

raceInfo.title: Circuit, weather and grid
raceInfo.empty: Pick a race to see the circuit, the weather and who is racing.

tyres.title: Tyres
tyres.note: Pace vs. base lap (negative = faster). Degradation is multiplied by this circuit’s tyre wear.

strategy.title: Build your strategy
strategy.empty: Pick a race to build your strategy.
